opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A), up to £500 (Scheme B), up to £750 (Adelphi co-sponsored), up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society junior scientist members: undergraduates, Masters and PhD students, and postdoctoral scientists within six years of PhD viva (Scheme A includes undergrads, Scheme B & C limited to PhD/postdoc). Applicants must be UK‑based or attending a UK conference.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at Genetics Society meetings, other genetics conferences, and virtual conferences, covering travel, accommodation and registration costs.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK (students must be members; others need at least one year membership).
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to attend short genetics‑related training courses or a collaborative laboratory visit.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK (students must be members; others need at least one year membership).
opportunities.summary: Supports travel, accommodation, subsistence and consumables for field‑based genetics research projects resulting in publishable data for the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Funds public engagement activities (in‑person or virtual) related to genetics, covering travel and material costs.

opportunities.title: Carer’s Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member, regardless of caring responsibility.
opportunities.summary: Provides a daily allowance to support attendance at Society meetings for members with caring responsibilities.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members proposing a genetics‑themed meeting in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship for ad‑hoc genetics meetings, covering venue, speaker travel, accommodation and related costs; applications accepted year‑round.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members proposing a new Special Interest Group to run regular meetings in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £2,000 annually to support regular series of meetings for genetics research communities, covering travel, accommodation, publicity and related costs.
